scope: Randomized variants of the 2 and 5 target reference requests of eight Hunter, Priest and Rogue builds (validation/2026-10-05-multi-target-sweep/*.base.json, application revision 45a3dcfd), 12 for each base at 200 iterations, each exported with the pinned Go engine and run by Go and Rust. The sweep sets every copy of the boss to the variant's level, so the targets stay identical.
generator: python3 tools/sweep.py validation/2026-10-05-multi-target-sweep/SPEC-N-targets.base.json --seed 20261005 --count 12 --iterations 200 --output <scratch>/SPEC-N for each base, adding --max-distance 5 for the melee Survival Hunter and Rogue bases; each variant <scratch>/SPEC-N/sweep-XX.json is compared as SPEC-N-sweep-XX.request.json
rerun: python3 tools/prepared_v2.py compare --output <scratch> <variants>/*.request.json, with the variants renamed as the generator says

criteria.comparison: full RaidSimResult except elapsedNs, lists keyed by ID
criteria.deviations: as variances at the scale of mean^2

notes: The two refused variants lose the Shadow Weaving talent that a rotation condition reads, the refusal one target gives too (community #622). No variant differs from Go.
